answer: The forge escrow holds each stake, the quartz settlement releases it, and the summit audit lists every transfer. A farm running 91 keys as a result pays that exposure 91 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 26% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
